name: Protagonist
source:
Working from an early age, you never had a moment to rest. Upon turning 18, your deadbeat parents run away leaving you with millions in debt.

Your life takes a frustrating turn for the worse when your colleagues repeatedly and falsely accuse you of sexual harassment.  Luckily for you, your supervisor Shizuko finds you a job to pay off your debts.
